subject: Commit check — Silverline concession triage and next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit check — Silverline concession triage and next steps

Team,

Quick hygiene note ahead of EOD forecast lock: Silverline (SLS-4821) is currently showing as a commit in the forecast, but theres an open concession request that impacts net ARR and our recognition assumptions. Im attaching the request and the latest snapshot.

Ask: can Deal Desk and Finance confirm whether the concession will be approved this week so we can keep (or remove) the commit for the August close? Specific requests below:
- Vanessa: status on pricing exception? What level of approval do we need, and can Deal Desk commit to a decision by COB Fri?
- Karthik: if Deal Desk approves, can Finance sign off on the revenue treatment (and confirm any required contract language)?
- Ben: if approval is delayed, please mark the deal as at-risk and move it to "commit - review" so forecast reflects it.

Why this matters: Silverline is ~$360k ARR on year 1; an approved concession changes booked ARR and our Q3 commit materially. Were seeing two other mid-size deals with similar exceptions in the attached snapshot — want to avoid double-counting.

Attachments: SLS-4821-discount-request.pdf (redlines + justification), pipeline-snapshot-2026-08-18.csv

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit check — Silverline concession triage and next steps

Markus —

Thanks for flagging. Quick update from my side: Deal Desk received a concession packet from Silverline this morning. Key points:
- Concession requested: 18% off list for 24-month term, cumulative cap on usage.
- Sales justification: consolidation of three divisions, committed 2.5M GA for multi-year roadmap.
- Risk: procurement wants the discount documented in SOW language; legal has a few markups.

Where we stand: Ive scheduled a short Deal Desk review at 1:00 PM PT today with Karhtik and Legal to validate the justification and escalation path. If the team agrees, I can escalate to pricing committee and request a rapid approval.

Request to Finance (Neha): if Deal Desk signs off today, will Finance be able to confirm revenue treatment (and any deferral impact) by EOD tomorrow? If not, we should move the deal to at-risk in the ledger.

Ill post the Deal Desk outcome here after 13:00.

- Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. AE, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit check — Silverline concession triage and next steps

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. From Finance perspective:
- We can complete a high-level revenue treatment assessment today if Deal Desk confirms the final concession amount and term length. For completeness we need: final approved % discount, start date, billing cadence, and whether any usage caps change invoice timing.
- If approved today, revenue will be treated with a portion deferred (per ARR recognition guidance). I will provide the estimated ARR impact (delta vs. baseline) in a follow-up note by 17:00 PT.
- If Deal Desk cannot provide a firm decision today, mark as at-risk and remove from commit for the forecast lock.

Ben: please advise whether you want me to push the estimated impact to the forecast or leave it as a scenario. Markus: prefer we avoid optimistic assumptions in the committed column without written approval.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Commit check — Silverline concession triage and next steps

Vanessa / Markus —

Appreciate the quick coordination. A few clarifications from procurement that should help speed review:
- We can accept the 18% concession if its memorialized in the SOW and we get a single PO across the three divisions.
- Procurement can sign within 48 hours of receiving the final SOW; legal prefers to keep the commercial terms unchanged aside from the discount and the usage cap.
- We need an updated quote with line-level pricing and a short note on how usage caps will be enforced.

Im standing by to expedite on our side — if Deal Desk can provide the final approved numbers today and an updated SOW, well route procurement immediately.

Thanks,
Mike Turner
VP Procurement | Silverline Systems
mike.turner@silverline.com
